title: Ember and Salt Revisited
author: Kestrel Winterbourne
blurb: Juniper Sterling, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
